# KeepNet Labs

> KeepNet Labs provides AI-powered human risk management and phishing simulation platforms to help organizations reduce security incidents through behavioral training and threat intelligence.

KeepNet Labs specializes in security awareness training and social engineering defense through multiple simulation vectors including email phishing, SMS (smishing), voice (vishing), QR code (quishing), and callback phishing attacks. The platform integrates with major enterprise tools and helps organizations measure and reduce human-driven security incidents.

## Key Topics

- Phishing Simulation
- Vishing Simulator
- Smishing Simulator
- Quishing Simulator

- Security Awareness Training

- Threat Sharing

## Simulation Products

- [Phishing Simulator](https://keepnetlabs.com/products/phishing-simulator): Keepnet's flagship phishing simulation platform for security awareness training
- [Vishing Simulator](https://keepnetlabs.com/products/vishing): Voice phishing simulation platform for social engineering defense training
- [Smishing Simulator](https://keepnetlabs.com/products/smishing-simulator): SMS phishing simulation tool for testing employee awareness and mobile security
- [Quishing Simulator](https://keepnetlabs.com/products/quishing-simulator): QR code phishing simulation to train employees against emerging attack vectors
- [Callback Voice Phishing Simulation](https://keepnetlabs.com/products/callback-phishing): AI-powered callback phishing simulator with 250+ templates and real-world training
- [Vishing as a Service](https://keepnetlabs.com/vishing-as-a-service): Managed vishing testing service for voice phishing security assessments
